items.title: Evidence is ‘reassuring’ for women who become pregnant while taking GLP-1 drugs
items.summary: Exposure to GLP-1 weight-loss and diabetes drugs around conception does not appear to be linked to a detectable increase in adverse outcomes for mothers or babies, a large review of the evidence has concluded.

items.title: NMC four-year midwifery strategy targets racism and safety
items.summary: The Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) has set out a four-year strategy for midwifery regulation aimed at supporting safer maternity care, with equity and anti-racism among its listed priorities.

items.title: Nurses asked for views in ‘NHS-wide conversation’ on maternity and neonatal services
items.summary: An NHS survey asking nurses to share their views and help shape improvements to maternity and neonatal services as part of an ‘NHS-wide conversation’ has opened today.

items.title: Global shortage of over 23 million nurses and midwives, researchers estimate
items.summary: Researchers estimate there is a global shortage of more than 23 million nurses and midwives which is the largest predicted shortfall across all healthcare workers, a study has revealed.

items.title: Multiple health conditions before pregnancy linked to complication risks
items.summary: Women who enter pregnancy with multiple long-term physical or mental health conditions face an increased risk of a wide range of complications, a study of more than 2.2 million pregnancies across the UK has found.

items.title: Guidelines on weight-loss drugs before and after pregnancy show stark gaps in evidence
items.summary: New guidelines developed to support the safe use of GLP-1 medicines before, during and after pregnancy are limited by gaps in the evidence, the researchers who developed them have said.

items.title: Nurses urged to prepare for ‘NHS-wide conversation’ on maternity and neonatal services
items.summary: Nurses are being urged to share their views and help shape improvements to maternity and neonatal services as part of an ‘NHS-wide conversation’ which opens later this month.
